name: plan-coverage-check
body: The plan-verify derived-coverage stage: computing the change-set's durable-spec delta from the branch's merge-base and requiring exactly that delta's `implemented-by` code FQNs to be touched by a plan task, plus the requirement-satisfies gate that requires every requirement added or changed in the same delta to be `Satisfies`'d by a plan phase. Anchored on `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` (the pure scope decision, a function of the delta and the plan tasks), `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.change_set_spec_delta` (the merge-base durable-spec-delta computation), and `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.plan_verify_at` (the wiring that supplies the delta and calls coverage). It owns the verify gate's derived-coverage decision — the set of `implemented-by` code FQNs a plan must touch and the set of delta requirements a phase must satisfy — and is the solution node the plan-coverage requirement's spine reaches. The verify refusal names the owning solution node and the uncovered code FQN for a coverage gap, and names the uncovered requirement FQN for an unsatisfied delta requirement.
